tools.name: get_rights_guide
tools.description: Read one Hebrew rights guide by its id, for example "tax/income-tax-exemption". Long guides return an overview and a list of sections; the optional "section" parameter returns one section. Each guide lists eligibility, amounts with dates, the claim process, forms and official sources.

tools.name: estimate_benefits
tools.description: Rough, anonymous estimate of Israeli benefits for one route: general disability pension, long-term care (nursing), work injury, or health-fund coverage.
